column1: # Difficulty pass. Aaron, 2026-08-30. Rank each halt 1-10 from the VIDEO ONLY --
# no model output, no README numbers, no demo. One pass, do not revisit.
#   1  = obvious; a referee giving it the other way would be a surprise
#  10  = genuine coin flip, arguable either way
# Higher = HARDER. Do a whole bout before moving on, so scale drift lands between
# bouts rather than inside one -- ranks are compared within bout.
# `awarded` is the referee's call, from your own contested tables. Seeing it is fine:
# the blindness that matters here is to MODEL output, not to the referee.
# `agree`   optional -- y/n, whether you'd have called it the same way. A halt you
#           disagree with is a different animal from one you find merely close.
# Blank = skipped, which is more useful than a forced guess.

column6: 10 (fencers are very small on this one, video is zoomed out hella)
